rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an audible sigh in everyday Cantonese.

example.english: I let out a sigh as soon as I heard the news.
example.traditional: 我一聽到個消息就嘆氣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 teng1 dou2 go3 siu1 sik1 zau6 taan3 hei3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for audibly sighing because of tiredness, sadness, frustration, or similar feelings.

example.english: I couldn't help but sigh when I heard the bad news.
example.traditional: 我聽到個壞消息，忍唔住嘆氣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou2 go3 waai6 siu1 sik1 jan2 m4 zyu6 taan3 hei3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the sigh expresses relief after learning that something is all right.

example.english: When I heard the operation was successful, I let out a sigh of relief.
example.traditional: 聽到手術成功，我先鬆一口氣。
example.jyutping: ting1 dou2 sau2 seot6 sing4 gung1 ngo5 sin1 sung1 jat1 hau2 hei3

rows.note: Use this when someone says or utters words while sighing, rather than merely making a sigh.

example.english: They said with a sigh, “I’m really tired.”
example.traditional: 佢嘆住氣講：「我真係攰喇。」
example.jyutping: keoi5 taan3 zyu6 hei3 gong2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gui6 laa3
